subject: Partner-led discovery: next steps & demo scheduling (CloudBridge)

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Aisha Patel <aisha@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from today - propose demo times (CloudBridge + Redwood)

Hi Marissa / Camila,

Great conversation earlier — thanks for walking through the Marketplace integration goals. To move to a technical deep dive/demo, Aisha (our Partner PM) and I can host a joint session with your SE to walk architecture, API flow, and deployment options. Proposed 60-min slots (PT):

- Mon Feb 23, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Tue Feb 24, 1:00–2:00 PM PT
- Wed Feb 25, 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Please confirm which slot works best and who from Redwood should attend (ideally an SE + someone for procurement/questions). Once you confirm, we will send a calendar invite with an agenda and a short prerequisites doc.

Also flagged a few topics we want to cover: Dedicated vs hosted routing, SSO/KMS requirements, and marketplace listing timeline.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Partner Solutions, CloudBridge
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
